reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"const repo = 'acme/web'; const issues = []; for (let page = 1; ; page++) { const result = await tools.list_issues({repo, state:'open', label:'perf', page}); issues.push(...result.items); if (result.items.length < 50) break; } const counts = new Map(); let total = 0; for (let i = 0; i < issues.length; i += 8) { const batch = await Promise.all(issues.slice(i, i+8).filter(issue => issue.comments > 0).map(async issue => { const logins = new Set(); let seen = 0; for (let page = 1; ; page++) { const result = await tools.list_comments({repo, number:issue.number, page}); const comments = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.items ?? result.comments; for (const comment of comments) logins.add(comment.user.login); seen += comments.length; if (comments.length < 50) break; } if (seen !== issue.comments) throw new Error(`Issue ${issue.number}: expected ${issue.comments}, got ${seen}`); return logins; })); for (const logins of batch) { total++; for (const login of logins) counts.set(login, (counts.get(login) ?? 0) + 1); } } return {issues:issues.length, commentedIssues:total, logins:[...counts].filter(([,count]) => count >= 4).map(([login]) => login).sort()};","answer":""}
